scope: Add the smallest framework-neutral optional ASGI response-header bytes encoding boundary so a host adapter can receive response header name/value pairs as Uint8Array without this module selecting or importing Uvicorn, Hypercorn, FastAPI, Django, Node HTTP, or any server.

change.added: optional encodeResponseHeader parameter on AsgiCoreProfileAdapter.call and .callFromReceive, plus a default UTF-8 response header encoder wired into createCustomerAsgiComposition.app
behavior: call({ scope, body, send, encodeResponseHeader }) and callFromReceive({ ..., encodeResponseHeader }) accept an optional encoder function
when encodeResponseHeader is omitted, call/callFromReceive/handle behavior and the internal profile event header shape (string name/value pairs) are unchanged

when encodeResponseHeader is supplied, it is applied to every http.response.start header name and value before send/return, including the deterministic 400 profile events raised on invalid scope, malformed receive events, and decodeBody throw

encodeResponseHeader is validated as a function when supplied (TypeError otherwise, no send/router invocation); an encoder throw propagates and is not caught, and send is not called after a header-encoder failure

createCustomerAsgiComposition.app now passes the existing JSON request decoder, the existing JSON response body encoder, and a new default UTF-8 response header encoder to asgi.callFromReceive, so host-adapter callers receive Uint8Array header pairs and Uint8Array body chunks
asgi.call/asgi.router/close direct-call behavior (no encoder) is unchanged

targeted: call without encodeResponseHeader preserves existing string header pairs
call with encodeResponseHeader converts success response headers to Uint8Array pairs and returns the same sent events
call with encodeResponseHeader applies to invalid-scope 400 profile events
callFromReceive with encodeResponseHeader applies to decode-error 400 profile events
callFromReceive with encodeResponseHeader applies to a malformed receive-event 400 profile response, with headers as Uint8Array pairs and sent equal to the returned events
encodeResponseHeader throw propagates and is not swallowed, and send is not called after failure
call/callFromReceive reject a non-function encodeResponseHeader without invoking send/receive
app(scope, receive, send) response start headers are Uint8Array pairs decoding to the expected content-type
all existing kernel-asgi-core-profile and kernel-create-customer-asgi-composition tests remain green
